answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment rather than node count, rendering the fable of infinite identity creation economically irrational. An attacker attempting to overwhelm the network faces a cost reaching its nadir only when they exhaust all available liquidity, an endeavor as prohibitively expensive as acquiring a saffron mountain. This stake-weighting ensures that identity falsification incurs direct financial ruin.
